difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S flat finite type, S Nagata integral regular of dimension 1 with function field K, and all generic residue extensions kappa(eta)/K separable, the lemma finds a finite separable extension L/K such that for T the normalization of S in L and nu : Y -> X x_S T the normalization, the structural map g : Y -> T is smooth at all generic points of fibres. The retained proof is written as an exact-parallel directive: the derivation mirrors line-for-line how the unreduced-but-reduced-fibre curve lemma (lemma normalized-base-change-with-reduced-fibre-over-curve, published chapter content) follows from the main normalized-base-change theorem (theorem normalized-base-change-with-reduced-fibre) — the curve case being the dimension-1 specialization where the generic flatness and excellent-descent bookkeeping simplify — with the separable theorem (theorem normalized-base-change-with-reduced-fibre-separable, the chapter's separable improvement) substituted for the main theorem; the separability hypotheses are exactly what the substituted theorem's statement demands, and the L/K separability clause transfers through the same base-change argument. Retained author proof at lines 19499-19506.
